logo.name: Logo
logo.wordmark_info: Shown when no logo image is set. Set in the display serif, letterspaced.

colors.name: Colours
colors.accent_note: One accent only. It is used for hairlines, hover underlines and small marks — never as a button fill or a gradient.

type.name: Typography
type.display_info: Headings, product titles and long-form prose.
type.prose_serif: Set long-form prose in the display serif
type.prose_serif_info: Journal articles and the brand story read as editorial rather than as a blog.

layout.name: Layout
layout.corners_info: Square is the house default. Rounded cards read as software, not as jewellery.
layout.reveal_info: A single 18px fade-and-rise, once per element. Disabled automatically for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

product.name: Product cards
product.metal: Show metal options on the card
product.metal_info: Reads the option named Metal and lists its values as small caps.

disclosure.name: Concept disclosure
disclosure.label: Disclosure line
disclosure.help: Shown quietly in the footer. Keep it if this store is a portfolio or concept build.
